summary: DocGo Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a merger agreement dated August 16, 2026, under which its subsidiary Ambulnz Holdings will acquire Hicuity Health via a merger. Consideration comprises DocGo common stock equal to 2.0% of fully diluted shares at closing plus earnout shares of 3.5% subject to vesting, with no upward adjustment. Due to Hicuity's liquidation preference, all consideration goes to Series F preferred holders; other classes are cancelled. The transaction is intended as a tax-free reorganization under Section 368(a). No financial terms, premiums, or advisors were disclosed. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing conditions.
